item.title: Bakery Product Mix 2026: Which Items Actually Make Money
item.description: Ask a struggling bakery owner which of their products makes the most money and you will usually get the wrong answer. They name the item that sells the most units — not the item that drops the most dollars to the bottom line. Those are almost never the same product. A bakery can be busy from open to close, sell out of everything, and still bleed cash, because the busiest SKUs are the ones with the thinnest contribution margin and the highest labor per unit.
